buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The Vehicle is required 24X7 (round the clock) with LOCAL & OUTSTATION movement. 2. The bid price must include all inclusive rate including Vehicle, Driver, Fuel, all kind of Tolls & Taxes or an y other charge. 3. The vehicle must be commercially registered as per Motor Vehicle Act and have valid insurance certifica te & Pollution under Control (PUC) certificate. The liability and risk of composite insurance covering vehicle theft, damage, injury of passengers and public due to accident etc. are responsibility of the Contractor only . 4. Vehicle should not be older than 3 calendar years, i.e. 2024, 2025 & 2026 and the vehicle should be BS- VI or latest. 5. A name plate of suitable size is required to be made and fitted on the front of the vehicle. The name pla te should read “POLICE”. 6. Vehicle colour should be white / white base colours. The vehicle should be mechanically sound and shal l be well maintained with neat and clean interior/exteriors and hygienic. Three pairs of seat-covers and tow els to be changed on alternate days. 7. Driver should be provided with white shirt and white pant. The cost of uniforms is to be borne by the co ntractor. 8. The driver must have the valid driving license, must possess good driving skill, obedient and courteous. Driver should not be suffering from hyperhidrosis or any other medical conditions resulting in foul body od our. Medical Certificate to this effect should be provided 9. All other terms and conditions of the contract for Hiring of Vehicles, which ar

e not specified; Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC), will be governed by Ser vice Level Agreement (SLA) for monthly basis cab & taxi hiring services of GeM Portal. 10. The vehicle should be available for any outstation duty during the Contract Period. The toll charges and other taxes for the outstation duty will be borne by the contractor. 11. In case of any break-down of the vehicle or in any other situation such as th e firm fails to provide the allocated category/model of vehicle, the firm must pro vide a higher category/model of vehicle as an alternative for stop-gap arrangem ent. 12. The tenderer shall submit their official address, Mobile / phone nos., e-mails , & Fax No. (if any) and the driver's mobile number for communication. 13. Driver should have a mobile phone with round the clock availability (24*7) t o attend movement/program details of the vehicle. Service provider should bear the charges regarding Phone call/SMS communication with the user. 14. Driver should not use mobile phone during driving. In emergency situation, he should park the vehicle and talk/communicate with the permission of the occ upant/passenger. 15. The Railway in no case shall be responsible for any legal matters arising out of any State or Central Govt. laws/rules in the matters of employing the driver b y vehicle's owner/Contractor. 16. The contractor shall bear the cost of repair or renewal of any kind of Railway properties if damaged by driver's negligence in rough driving, carelessness. In r egard to assessment of such loss on account of damages, the decision of the Of ficer for whom vehicle is hired or his representative will be considered as final a nd binding on the Contractors. 17. Contractor shall be fully responsible for any repair, accident, loss and dama ges to the vehicle and driver. If any fine or penalty is imposed by various author ities such as Road Transport Officers/Authorities, Traffic Police etc. for any violat ion such as speed, traffic rules violation etc., the same will have to be borne by the contractor only. 18. All hired vehicles should be equipped with prescribed emergency kit and a f ire extinguisher as per statutory provision. 19. No sub-contracting shall be allowed in any case. Vehicles should be in the n ame of the bidder and no subletting would be permitted. 20. The contractor shall submit the bill for the month or part thereof by 7th of t he following month. The bill must accompany the certification of the officer/Secr etary of PHODs/CHODs/AGM/DRM using the vehicles having day-wise use and kil ometer of vehicle and also furnish other documents such as Toll tax, Parking fee s which need to be countersigned by the officer. 21. However, any penalty or fines etc. imposed by RTA, Police or other law enfo rcing agencies due to failure/violation of traffic rules etc. are not payable to the contractor and such risk and cost will be borne by the contractor.

22. Bidders must submit all documents/certificates required in bid failing which the offer shall be ignored. 23. AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Servi ce Provider must be located in the City of Consignee i.e. Kolkata. DOCUMENTAR Y EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. Other terms and condition will be as per GeM SLA, GeM GCC and other conditions shall be as per GeM updated from time to time. .
